metrics.profile_summary: Strategic marketing leader with extensive experience in brand management and digital growth across multiple verticals. Proven track record in scaling consumer brands, leading cross-functional teams, and executing integrated multi-channel strategies.

experience.description: Leads marketing strategy, budget, and brand governance for four verticals; manages a team of four and drove a 200% increase in inbound leads.
Directed end-to-end rebranding and digital growth strategy to position the firm as a knowledge-led consulting entity.
Focused on LinkedIn growth, executive branding for the CEO, and lead generation through content optimization.
Executed marketing campaigns and event calendars while managing client relationships and product positioning.
Led a large-scale virtual job fair and managed community outreach and social media strategy.
Built a consumer brand from scratch, achieving 1000% organic social media growth and training 3,000+ women in digital marketing.

strengths: Strong leadership and people management experience
Proven track record in brand scaling and integrated campaigns
Relevant academic background with an MBA
Experience managing budgets and high-level strategy
weaknesses: No explicit mention of GA4 or specific ad platform reporting tools
evaluation.summary: Highly qualified candidate with the required seniority and leadership experience. While GA4 is not explicitly listed, her role as Head of Marketing overseeing performance marketers suggests the necessary oversight capability.
